SCENE LAYERS:
- Background: Towering, overcast Victorian Gothic-inspired stone and brick edifices of the City of London, with subtle glints of modern glass skyscrapers in the distance, hinting at the financial hub gravitas.
- Midground: The facade of the Elite Fashion Boutique, a stately stone edifice with large, sleek glass frontage. Polished brass accents frame the entrance, and branded signage in a subtle, designer font is tastefully displayed. Mannequins are spotlighted behind the glass, showcasing designer apparel. A hint of ironwork details adorns nearby structures, reflecting the Industrial Revolution grit.
- Foreground: The bustling street-level perspective, showing a portion of the polished stone pavement with subtle reflections from the boutique's windows. A few blurred figures of pedestrians contribute to the busy and labyrinthine feel of the city.

LIGHTING: Soft, diffused overcast daylight casting a muted, formal grey tone across the scene. A subtle, warm gaslight glow emanates from nearby historic lampposts, contrasting with the cool, reflective surfaces of the boutique's glass. Shadows are soft and elongated, suggesting the late afternoon.
ATMOSPHERE: Prestigious and formal, with an air of exclusive aspiration. The scene evokes a sense of historic guild hall echoes and Victorian Gothic grandeur, mixed with the efficient and business-oriented atmosphere of a financial hub. A touch of melancholic mystery pervades, enhanced by the muted colors and diffused light.

Visual Identity: Victorian Gothic grandeur, Industrial Revolution grit, Financial hub gravitas, Historic guild hall echoes, Chic display window, Designer label allure
Forms & Materials: Stone and brick monoliths, Ironwork and glass, Stately stone edifices, Polished brass accents, Sleek glass frontage, Branded signage

[SPACE:] exterior
[CAMERA:] camera positioned on approach path with elevated perspective, 25-30° downward tilt, ultra-wide view capturing entrance within broader environmental context, entrance visible but not dominating frame, extensive surroundings visible, layered depth from immediate foreground through distant background, balanced composition showing full architectural context
[LENS:] 12-24mm ultra-wide lens, elevated perspective, expansive framing
[LIGHT:] directional natural light with atmospheric haze, environmental motion (wind-blown mist, drifting clouds, shifting shadows), parallax depth through weather conditions

[NEG:] Excessive cyberpunk neon, Fantasy magic props


[FILTER: NoLivingSubjects] DON'T INCLUDE:
[NEG:] humans, people, faces, characters, animals, creatures, silhouettes, bodies, watermark, signature.
